routes.name: Stored low/middle-depth interpolation
routes.method: Degree7 interpolation in u, with degree11 interpolation in log(r+1) across12 anchors for unstored counts. Dense exact integer counts0–255, geometric anchor spacing factor0.083071 to r_max2e8 plus8 pad anchors. Use C pmm_interp_column when available.

routes.name: Historical high-depth fast kernel
routes.depths: L>=54 dispatch; recorded end-to-end test only reaches Lmax54
routes.method: _saddle_row calls log_phi_column. It uses a small-t series under its threshold, otherwise55 vectorized bisection steps and an order2 saddle correction from F2,F3,F4. This function contains no contour integration fallback. It is NumPy/SciPy code, not the native outer peak solver.
routes.code_validation_limit: Function accepts depths beyond the stored design range through early dispatch, but acceptance of138 was not established by the recovered historical reports.

routes.name: Native C interpolation and profile peak solve
routes.method: ctypes wrapper builds a platform/source-hash-keyed shared library when imported and defaults to enabling it. If missing/unbuildable, Python fallback is silent. Compiler flags -O3 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -fPIC -shared. Existing binaries alone do not prove the current ALT process loaded them.

history_and_pitfalls.fact: Evening correction exonerated ladder after fixing noisy Laplace curvature; dense trapezoidal peak integration agrees where old node/solve-curvature logic failed. It also identified contaminated large-r columns in old universal_v2; do not use that historical cache as an unquestioned exact reference.

Right-pole series cancellation bug was fixed by differential exponent assembly and cancellation-aware certificate; commit4267ff6. The reference probe_exact store was then frozen read-only in the historical workflow.

The later phrase “tables-free evaluator” describes pairwise prediction-table construction, with792of802s still spent in layered-table work; it is not evidence of a new universal higher-depth phi interpolation store.

recoverable_next_actions_without_changin: Compare native availability/configuration in the ALT vendor wrapper with PMWM kernel.py; restoring C stencil/peak implementations can preserve the stored-grid arithmetic independently of any change to the high-depth kernel approximation.

Use the recorded four-variable configuration and unmodified PMWM source as the historical fast-route reference, with the independent contour/reference path as its numerical comparator; do not treat the C peak solver as the Mellin high-depth saddle shortcut.

If every ALT high-depth kernel must be served from interpolation, the audit found no ready local store above53. A separate offline-built immutable extension would be required; the current UniversalTables.column design guard is70, so mere configuration does not supply138-depth stored coverage.

Select acceptance from the existing ALT required accuracy metrics and saved profiles. The recovered historical speed and corpus-average agreements establish the intended design, but their domains do not by themselves establish the required L80/L138 results.
